data.name: Ambuja
data.gender_notes: Ambuja is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ambuja is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘ambu,’ meaning lotus. In Hindu mythology, the lotus symbolizes spiritual growth, purity, and enlightenment. The name Ambuja is therefore associated with these qualities and is often given to girls to bless them with a strong spiritual foundation and a pure heart. The name Ambuja carries the meaning “Lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ambuja usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ambuja belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ambuja total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
